_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

docket_number.label: Docket Number
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

in_re_name.label: In Re Name
in_re_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

declarant_name.label: Declarant Name
declarant_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

declarant_address.label: Declarant Address
declarant_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

waiver_type.label: Waiver Type
waiver_type.expects: check only if the statement is true

limited_proceedings.label: Limited Proceedings
limited_proceedings.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

date.label: Date
date.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

person_waiving_notice.label: Person Waiving Notice
person_waiving_notice.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
